components.summary: Chooses the tile layer the block occupies and therefore how it is drawn and collided with.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: Defaults to wall when kurblanc:wall is present, otherwise floor. Not validated by the block parser.

components.behavior: An unknown value is not a load error; the renderer decides what to do with it. Use one of the three documented names.

components.summary: Fallback colour used for block previews, particles and light when no light colour is given.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: Six hexadecimal digits; three-digit shorthand is rejected.

components.summary: Human-readable name shown in the inventory, tooltips and error messages.

fields.name: value
fields.default: The local ID with underscores replaced by spaces
fields.notes: Falls back to the local part of the identifier when omitted.

components.summary: Allows or forbids placing this block from an item. Door and gate states use it to make the open state unplaceable.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: The closed state of a toggle pair must be placeable; the open state must set it to false.

components.behavior: kurblanc:placeable must be a boolean. A toggle's open state must set it to false, and its closed state must not.

components.summary: Marks the block solid for the player, mobs and placement checks.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: Independent of light opacity. Floors are walkable even when solid is false.

components.summary: How much sky and block light the tile absorbs, on the same 0–15 scale as light emission.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: 0 is fully transparent, 15 blocks all light. This is not collision.

components.summary: Sets how long the block takes to mine.

fields.name: seconds_to_destroy
fields.default: Unbreakable when the component is omitted
fields.notes: Stored as tenths of a second; 1.2 becomes 12 ticks of hardness.

components.behavior: seconds_to_destroy must be positive. The component may also be set to false, which leaves the block unbreakable.

components.summary: Makes the block a light source.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: The light colour comes from kurblanc:light_color, then kurblanc:color.

components.summary: Sets the colour of the light emitted by the block.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: Only read when kurblanc:light_emission is present. Not validated by the block parser; use six hexadecimal digits.

components.behavior: No parser-level check here. A malformed colour can reach the renderer; keep it to #rrggbb.

components.summary: Lists the items awarded when the block is mined.

fields.name: value
fields.range: items must be namespaced and defined in an active logic pack
fields.notes: Validated after every pack loads, because the item definitions may come from another pack.

components.behavior: kurblanc:drops must be an array. A missing item or a bare ID fails validation and names the block file.

components.summary: Binds the block to its texture and optional crop.

fields.name: *.texture
fields.range: AP path ending in .png, under textures/
fields.notes: The * key is the primary face; up is accepted as an alternative. No .. segments.

fields.name: *.rect
fields.notes: Crops the primary texture on its sheet.

fields.name: *.tint
fields.notes: Multiplies the texture colour.

fields.name: front.texture
fields.range: AP path ending in .png, under textures/
fields.notes: Legacy separate front face. D25 walls use one combined sheet instead.

components.behavior: A bad path fails with: must be an AP path such as "textures/blocks/stone.png". A bad crop fails the rect rule.

components.summary: Selects the ground autotiling archetype and its natural-terrain options.

fields.name: random_rotate
fields.notes: Rotates plain fills and connected interiors by stable quarter-turns.

fields.name: group
fields.notes: Connects variants of the same material for tiling.

fields.name: substrate
fields.notes: The material this ground is placed on.

fields.name: tint
fields.notes: Not validated here; use a six-digit colour.

fields.name: biome_tint
fields.notes: Recolours natural ground per tile from the generator's biome tint. Only true enables it.

components.behavior: The component must be an object. Values are coerced rather than rejected; keep to the documented types.

components.summary: Selects the 47-shape construction surface autotiling archetype.

fields.name: group
fields.notes: Connects variants of the same surface material.

components.behavior: The component must be an object. A surface and a ground component on the same block: surface wins because it is read later.

components.summary: Selects the raised wall archetype and its one-sheet top/front art.

fields.name: lift
fields.notes: Wall top elevation in source pixels.

fields.name: group
fields.notes: Connects wall variants for autotiling.

fields.name: top_rect
fields.notes: Escape hatch for a top region that is not in the standard position.

fields.name: front_rect
fields.notes: Escape hatch for a front strip that is not in the standard position.

components.behavior: Lift must be an integer 0-32. Rect overrides must be valid crops. Without a front region the wall draws top-only.

components.summary: Makes a floor tile behave as water with a visible submerged bed.

fields.name: bed
fields.notes: The floor material seen through the water.

fields.name: opacity
fields.notes: Water tint strength, not the light opacity component.

components.behavior: kurblanc:water.bed must be a namespaced block ID. kurblanc:water.opacity must be from 0 to 1.

components.summary: Selects the raised-object archetype, including sprite crops, depth and foliage.

fields.name: height
fields.notes: Visual height in source pixels. Does not change collision.

fields.name: shadow
fields.notes: The only accepted value is sprite, which projects the sprite alpha.

fields.name: contact_shadow
fields.notes: A root-contact ellipse for objects that should not use the full sprite silhouette.

fields.name: sprite_offset
fields.notes: Moves the sprite relative to the tile.

fields.name: rect
fields.notes: Crops the object from its sheet.

fields.name: vertical_rect
fields.notes: Alternate crop used when the object is drawn on a vertical face.

fields.name: vertical_offset
fields.notes: Offset for the vertical-face crop.

fields.name: vertical_masks
fields.notes: Cardinal masks selecting which vertical faces use the alternate crop.

fields.name: depth
fields.notes: Draw-order offset for the ground-layer sprite.

fields.name: vertical_depth
fields.notes: Draw-order offset for the vertical-face sprite.

fields.name: group
fields.notes: Groups variants for shared rendering behaviour.

fields.name: random_flip
fields.notes: Horizontally mirrors the sprite from a stable tile hash.

fields.name: variant_rects
fields.notes: Additional sprite variants sharing the same placement.

fields.name: foliage.canopyEnd
fields.notes: Fraction of the sprite treated as canopy. Field name is camelCase.

fields.name: foliage.leafTextures
fields.notes: Leaf art used for ambient flutter. Field name is camelCase.

components.behavior: Crops, offsets, masks and foliage ranges are checked. Bad rects, masks or foliage fail with the component path.

components.summary: Links matching toggleable blocks so they open and close together.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: Both halves of a double door use the same pair value.

components.summary: Turns one door or gate definition into the closed block and its generated open state.

fields.name: closed
fields.notes: Overrides shared components for the closed state. Must remain placeable.

fields.name: open
fields.notes: Overrides shared components for the open state. Must set kurblanc:placeable to false.

components.behavior: Must contain exactly closed and open. The loader generates `${identifier}_open`, cross-links kurblanc:toggle, and refuses a placeable open state or an unplaceable closed state.

components.summary: The ID of the other state in a door or gate pair.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: Written by the loader when it expands kurblanc:toggle_states. Do not author it by hand.

components.behavior: Generated and cross-linked by the loader. An authored value is overwritten for a toggle pair.
